title: selliguea hirtella
intro: Selliguea hirtella, commonly known as the hairy spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal disorders. The health benefits of Selliguea hirtella can be attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
